goal: 向老师解释迟到并取得谅解

n1.speaker: 老师 Teacher
n1.line: You are twenty minutes late. I waited for you to start the experiment. What happened?
n1.lineCn: 你迟到了二十分钟。我一直等你来才开始实验。发生什么事了?

grammar.name: 状语从句引导词
grammar.note: 解释原因时用 because / so that 等连词把句子连接起来。

options.text: I am sorry, Miss Gao. Because my mother suddenly fell ill, I had to take her to the hospital before I came to school.
options.textCn: 对不起,高老师。因为我妈妈突然生病了,我上学前得先送她去医院。
options.feedback: 用 because 说明原因,还补充了时间顺序,诚恳可信。

options.text: I just woke up late. Sorry.
options.feedback: 虽然诚实,但理由轻描淡写,显得态度不端正。
拒绝解释,老师没法了解情况。

n2.speaker: 老师 Teacher
n2.line: Oh, I am sorry to hear that. Is she better now? Even though you were late, helping your family comes first.
n2.lineCn: 哦,听到这个消息我很遗憾。她现在好些了吗?虽然你迟到了,但照顾家人是最重要的。

grammar.name: Even though 让步状语从句
grammar.note: Even though 引导让步状语从句,表示"尽管……仍然"。

options.text: She is much better now, so I could come to school. I will ask my desk mate for the notes as soon as I sit down.
options.textCn: 她现在好多了,所以我才能来上学。我一坐下就找同桌借笔记。
options.feedback: 用 so 表因果、as soon as 表时间,还主动提出补课。

options.text: She is fine. But I still do not want to talk about it.
options.textCn: 她没事,但我还是不想谈这个。
options.feedback: 回避话题,老师想了解细节也很难。

n3.speaker: 老师 Teacher
n3.line: I see. But you know, the experiment cannot wait while we are waiting for you. Can you tell me the real reason?
n3.lineCn: 我明白了。但你知道的,大家等你的这段时间实验都没法开始。能告诉我真实原因吗?

grammar.name: while 时间状语从句
grammar.note: while 引导时间状语从句,强调"在等待你的时候"。

options.text: The truth is that my alarm clock did not ring because of a power cut last night. I promise I will set two alarms from now on.
options.textCn: 实情是昨晚停电,我的闹钟没响。我保证从今以后设两个闹钟。
options.feedback: 给出具体原因并用 because of 解释,还提出补救办法。

options.text: I will not tell you. It is none of your business.
options.textCn: 我不会告诉你,这不关你的事。
options.feedback: 对老师这样说话,态度恶劣。

n4.speaker: 老师 Teacher
n4.line: Thank you for being honest. Although you missed the beginning, you can still join us now. Do you understand the steps so far?
n4.lineCn: 谢谢你的诚实。虽然你错过了开头,但现在还能加入。到目前为止的步骤你明白吗?

grammar.name: Although 让步状语从句
grammar.note: Although 引导让步从句,主句不接 but,表"虽然……但是"。

options.text: Not yet. Could you explain it again so that I can catch up quickly?
options.textCn: 还不明白。您能再讲一遍,好让我快点跟上吗?
options.feedback: 用 so that 表目的,主动请求补课,学习态度积极。

options.text: I understand nothing, but I will just watch.
options.textCn: 我什么都不懂,但我就看着吧。
options.feedback: 放弃参与实验,浪费时间。

n5.speaker: 老师 Teacher
n5.line: Okay. As long as you are honest with me, I trust you. Now, would you like to join the experiment group?
n5.lineCn: 好吧。只要你对我诚实,我就信任你。现在,你想加入实验小组吗?

grammar.name: As long as 条件状语从句
grammar.note: As long as 引导条件从句,表示"只要……就"。

options.text: Yes, I would love to. I will be more careful so that I will not hold the group back.
options.textCn: 愿意,我想加入。我会更细心,这样才不会拖小组后腿。
options.feedback: 接受安排并用 so that 表目的,态度诚恳。

options.text: No, I want to leave early because I am bored.
options.textCn: 不,我想早点走,因为太无聊了。
options.feedback: 迟到了还嫌无聊,老师的耐心也会耗尽。

n6.speaker: 老师 Teacher
n6.line: No problem. I will walk you through the steps once more. Since you explained your reason honestly, we can all move on. Agreed?
n6.lineCn: 没问题,我再带你过一遍步骤。既然你诚实解释了原因,这件事就翻篇了。可以吗?

grammar.name: Since 原因状语从句
grammar.note: Since 引导原因状语从句,表"既然",语气比 because 轻。

options.text: Yes, thank you! I have learned my lesson, and I will never be late again without a good reason.
options.textCn: 好的,谢谢您!我吸取教训了,以后没有正当理由绝不会再迟到。
options.feedback: 真诚认错并给出承诺,成功取得老师谅解。

options.text: Fine, but I am still angry that you made me wait.
options.textCn: 行吧,但我还是很生气,是你让我等的。
options.feedback: 倒打一耙,把责任推给老师,谅解泡汤。

success.speaker: 老师 Teacher
success.line: Good. Everyone makes mistakes. Now, let us focus on the experiment!
success.lineCn: 好,人都会犯错。现在,我们专心做实验吧!

fail1.speaker: 老师 Teacher
fail1.line: That is not an acceptable attitude. Please wait outside until you are ready to talk properly.
fail1.lineCn: 这不是能接受的态度。请到外面等着,直到你愿意好好说话。

fail2.speaker: 老师 Teacher
fail2.line: I am quite disappointed. The experiment is starting now, with or without you.
fail2.lineCn: 我很失望。实验现在开始,不管你是否参加。
